about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples: card t_0f1197e6 (row 478). scripts/mutation_check.sh resolved the venv from the script's OWN checkout (SCRIPT_HOME) only, so a linked git worktree added without its own `.venv` symlink fell through to a bare `python3` on PATH -- usually one with no pytest, so `make gate` failed the B0 precheck (exit 2) everywhere except the main checkout. Fix round 1 (Opus review) adopts the same order as the sibling scripts/htc_post_run.sh: $SCOUTER_PYTHON, then this checkout's own venv, then the MAIN checkout's venv found via `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` (guarded to a `.git` basename, so it never picks a bare-repo sibling's venv or a submodule's nested common dir), before falling back to bare `python3` on PATH. Run by tests/intent/test_gate_venv_resolution_intent.py against the real scripts/mutation_check.sh, copied byte-for-byte into a throwaway fixture git repo (never rewritten -- production code, not a mock) with real venvs built by `python3 -m venv --without-pip` (real interpreters, not stub executables) and a linked worktree, exactly mirroring the bug's reproduction. Two real oracles per example (Z2): the resolved interpreter's own reported path (identity-compared without chasing a venv's `bin/python3` symlink back to its base interpreter), AND that interpreter's own `sys.prefix` when actually run.
subject: scripts/mutation_check.sh (the PYTHON resolution chain)

examples.source: row 478: a bare `git worktree add` (no .venv symlink, no venv of its own) must still find the main checkout's real venv via git's common dir, not fall back to a pytest-less system python3

explicit $SCOUTER_PYTHON must win even when a main-checkout venv is also resolvable, so a caller can always point at a specific interpreter; the override target is a dedicated second venv, distinct from both the main venv and the test's own interpreter (review I1)
row 478 done-when is additive only: with no override, no venv of the worktree's own, and no main-checkout venv at all, the pre-existing SCRIPT_HOME/.venv-then-bare-python3 fallback must be unchanged

review I3: this repo's other resolver (scripts/htc_post_run.sh) checks the checkout's own venv BEFORE the main checkout's, and mutation_check.sh must match -- a worktree with its own real venv (e.g. for a dependency bump) must not be shadowed by the main checkout's
